performance.verdict: Paid ads fully dark; organic collapse signals deeper visibility crisis, not ads problem.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days (Meta $0, Google $0); CPL is undefined — no paid engine is generating any leads at all.
OVERDUE: Dashboard live + August scoreboard trusted milestones both due 2026-08-31 — client's stay/walk renewal decision is now at risk with 0 leads delivered.
OVERDUE: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) both unresolved — scoreboard cannot be trusted without these.
GBP actions dropped 50% week-over-week (211 total in 28d); last 3 days show 0 GBP actions vs avg ~7/day in prior 3 weeks — listing visibility sharply deteriorating.
Search Console clicks fell 75.86% week-over-week; last 3 days show 0 clicks vs avg ~3/day prior — organic search discovery has effectively stopped in the most recent window.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP listing immediately — 3 consecutive days of 0 actions signals suspension or critical listing error.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for the last 3 days (Aug 29–31) after averaging ~7/day across August — this pattern matches a listing suspension or ownership/verification issue. Pull the GBP dashboard today and check for any suspension notice, pending verification requests, or policy flags. Success check: GBP actions return to ≥5/day within 3 days of resolution. Re-check 2026-09-04.

suggestions.text: Escalate dashboard + attribution gap delivery to Nacer today — client renewal decision is already overdue as of 2026-08-31.
suggestions.monday_update: Three milestones are past due: phone-match attribution (Aug 7), sync/contact cleanup (Aug 14), and the live dashboard tied to the stay/walk renewal decision (Aug 31). With 0 leads generated in August and the scoreboard unreadable, the client has no basis to renew. Nacer must confirm delivery dates for the dashboard and attribution gap closure by 2026-09-03. Success check: dashboard is live and client has confirmed they can see lead-to-patient data before the next renewal conversation.

suggestions.text: Watch SC clicks — 0 clicks for 3 consecutive days; confirm whether GBP and organic drops share a root cause before any SEO action.
suggestions.monday_update: Search Console clicks dropped 75.86% week-over-week and hit 0 for Aug 29–31, mirroring the GBP actions collapse. Both could share a single cause (e.g., a site crawl error, manual action, or Google listing issue). Do not initiate new SEO work until the GBP audit (S1) rules out a listing-level cause. Re-check both metrics on 2026-09-04; if SC clicks remain at 0, escalate to a Search Console manual actions review.
